class.name: GodotDoctorNodeValidationCollection
class.brief_description: A collection of validation messages for nodes.

method.name: add_node_validation
method.description: Adds the validation [param messages] for [param node_ancestor_path] to the collection. Fails if [param node_ancestor_path] already has validation messages in the collection.

method.name: get_node_ancestor_path_to_validation_messages_map
method.description: Returns the map of node ancestor paths to their validation messages.

members.member: A dictionary mapping node ancestor paths to their validation messages. [code]key[/code] is the node ancestor path as a [String], and [code]value[/code] is [code]Array[lb]GodotDoctorValidationMessage[rb][/code].
